The bottles you will find at our bar in Agra

Our shelves are one of the main reasons guests ask about us when they look for the best bar in Agra. Here is a look at the kinds of bottles you will see behind the counter. Stock changes from time to time, so please call us to confirm a specific brand.

🥃

Scotch whisky

Blended Scotch is a favourite across Uttar Pradesh. Our shelves include Johnnie Walker Red Label and Black Label, 100 Pipers aged 12 years and VAT 69. Johnnie Walker is known for its smoky, balanced character and works neat, on the rocks or with soda. 100 Pipers 12 is a smooth, easy-drinking choice for guests who prefer something mellow. VAT 69 has a long history and a firm following among those who like a classic blended Scotch.

☘️

Irish whiskey

If you enjoy something lighter and softer, look for Jameson and Bushmills. Irish whiskey is typically triple distilled, which gives it a smooth finish that suits people who are new to whisky as well as long-time drinkers.

🍸

Gin

Bombay Sapphire is easy to spot with its blue bottle. It is a vapour infused London Dry gin with bright, aromatic notes that make a clean gin and tonic. We also stock Terai, a craft gin from the Himalayan foothills, for guests who want to try something with a more local story.

🧊

Vodka

Smirnoff is one of the world's most popular vodkas, and its flavoured range makes it a good base for easy mixed drinks. Pair it with juice, soda or Red Bull, depending on your mood.

🍹

Rum

Old Monk is an Indian classic with a loyal following. Our shelf includes the Old Monk XO coffee flavoured rum, a good pick for guests who enjoy something rich and slightly sweet.

🥤

Mixers and soft drinks

A good bar in Agra is also about what goes alongside the spirit. We keep chilled Red Bull, soda and water ready, so your drink is served cold and the way you like it.

A quick guide to ordering at a bar in Agra

If you are new to spirits, a few simple tips will help you enjoy your evening and get the most from our shelves.

🎯

Start with what you like

Tell our team what you usually drink and how you take it. If you enjoy smooth, light flavours, Irish whiskey or a vodka with juice is a gentle start. If you like bolder, smokier flavours, try a blended Scotch such as Johnnie Walker Red Label or Black Label.

🍸

Try gin with tonic

A gin and tonic is one of the simplest and most refreshing drinks in Agra's warm weather. Bombay Sapphire is crisp and aromatic, while Terai gives you a craft gin to compare against it.

🗣️

Ask about serving style

Neat, on the rocks, with soda or with a mixer all taste different. There is no wrong way. Pick the one that suits your taste and your pace.

💧

Do not skip the food and water

Eating well and sipping water between drinks keeps the evening enjoyable and keeps you in control.
